question: Should `TOOL_PROGRESS_KIND` and `isToolProgressPayload` become the permanent public plugin SDK contract for cross-plugin progress intent?
rationale: The contract is additive and generically named, but it expands a deliberately constrained third-party SDK surface and cannot be treated as an internal implementation detail after release.

options.title: Approve the generic contract
options.body: Keep the narrow generic constant and predicate after the native-block behavior and contract coverage are complete.

options.title: Keep the intent private
options.body: Replace the public export with another owner-approved internal or channel-local seam before merging.

recommendation.title: Approve the generic contract
recommendation.body: Keep the narrow generic constant and predicate after the native-block behavior and contract coverage are complete.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent work by this contributor defines the native Slack presentation path and adjacent plugin SDK integration boundary affected by the decision.
